nodes.asset_description: A solid white rectangle is centered on a black background. The rectangle is uniformly filled and has a uniform thickness.

A light blue beaker with a black rim and handle is tilted against a white background. Inside the beaker, a light blue liquid is visible, marked with small white bubbles. The beaker’s scale is visible, with black lines marking the measurements.
A yellow liquid is contained within a clear tube with a white cap. The tube is angled diagonally against a white background. Six small black dashes are visible along the length of the tube.
A pink and yellow battery with a yellow top and a white cap is shown against a white background. The battery has a black plus symbol and a black minus symbol on its surface.
A cartoon drawing of a dropper with a pink cap and beige body contains a blue liquid. A single drop of liquid is falling from the tip. The background is black.

A stylized molecular model depicts a central red sphere with six yellow spheres connected by black lines. The spheres are arranged in a roughly symmetrical pattern, with some overlapping. The background is white.
A pair of light blue-framed safety glasses with a teal droplet on the bridge rests against a white background. The glasses are angled slightly downward and to the right.
